title: Close fences the runner: no advance letter after a rejection, none before
deviations_from_card: Applied the critic revision: the close half was already fixed by 5075b3b08, so case 3 is a guard (green before; now driven through the real promoteSubmission door, asserts notified:1 and the one rejection addressed to the non-promoted submitter), and case 2 (wrapUpRecipients) is the optional extraction of the rule close/route.ts:72 held; the close route now calls it once over every posting's submissions (dedupe across postings unchanged) and closes the postings after the sends. Added the per-promote progress tick ('promoting N') and a 'publishing' tick before the mint, as the revision asked. Stop precedence is canceled > moved > paused. The fence also runs before each advance letter (after the awaited observed-skills mint), and the promote loop's canceled detail write is now expectedStage-guarded. Audit actions: 'stage_moved' and 'posting_withdrawn' (no closed audit vocabulary exists). Commits: one feat commit carrying code + tests (a tests-only commit would have been red, since the fence test pins orchestrator source) plus the doc commit alone under the lock.
notes: Red before (tests written first, fence module moved aside): fence test file 5 tests red (cases 1, 2, 7), orchestrator 3 new cases red (cases 4, 5, 6); close case 3 green (5075b3b08); case 8 regression all green. After: fence 5/5, orchestrator 11/11, close route 5/5, plus 100/100 across devcase api tests, close-tenancy, lifecycle-tenancy, redesign-gate, route-capability-coverage, devcase-source-promote-tenancy (every recordAudit stamps workspaceId), status-tone, devcase-vocabulary, devcase-transitions. tsc: only foreign errors (untracked kpi-sim/ tree and a sibling's in-flight app/_lib/sanity-checks.test.ts); none on my paths. Full test:unit exit 1 on two foreign files only: recipes-literals ratchet on features/insights/analytics/sections/QualityHireRatingQueue.tsx (a sibling's uncommitted UI) and python-runner-concurrency (process-tree kill on Windows, unrelated). test:perf exit 1 on the working tree: 39 api-route overage lines of +1 module / ~+12 KB. Measured base 3d6e41446 + my three source files alone via git archive into scratch and scripts/perf/check-budget.mjs evaluate(): findings [] - my share (+1 module, ~+9 KB on routes that reach the orchestrator) fits under every ceiling, so the overage needs a sibling's uncommitted files to trip; no perf-budget.json change made. Hand-off for devcase-orchestration/B: the fence is the `fence()` / `stageMoved()` / `haltedAt()` / `stopPromoting()` closures at the top of the runLifecycle iteration and the promote loop; outcome writes can sit beside the existing `detail` writes without touching the stop checks.
